pages.text: $(l)Ember Figs$() hang under the canopy of Ember trees (Ember Grove, Hellwood Jungle). Ripe, they glow: right-click to pick them, they grow back. Eating one grants $(item)Fire Resistance$() (15 s).
$(l)Withered Plums$() hang under Withered trees. Eating one $(l)cures Wither$() and heals a little: precious against Withered Knights and the Champion.
Plant a fruit under a matching wart block (also vanilla Nether or Warped Wart Blocks) to grow your own clusters; bone meal speeds them up. Breaking a canopy block may also drop a fruit.
pages.title: Cultiver
